description: drowzeys' keys-heretic MiniMax H3 stack as the creator publishes it, run from the creator's image: ComfyUI with Sage attention, Sol-Attn, Spectrum and FirstBlockCache, 20 steps, seed 45, 864x480 for 124 frames at 24 fps, then RealESRGAN x2 to a 1728x960 H.264 MP4 with sound. The text encoder is abliterated (refusal-removed, Heretic ARA); the video model, the transformer and the VAEs, is stock MiniMax H3. The creator reports 319.9 s end to end on a GB10 (an upstream claim, not measured here). One compatibility fix to the creator's workflow: SolAttnPatch gets int8_pv false and dense_blocks empty, the two required inputs the creator's image added after the workflow was benched; they reproduce the benched behaviour. 104 GB peak is an unqualified planning estimate. Physical Spark and quality acceptance remain pending. MiniMax H3 Community License terms and territory information are recorded in the model.
title: MiniMax H3 keys-heretic (abliterated encoder) video and audio single Spark
